results.title: Google Ads Benchmarks: Compare & Measure Your PPC Metrics
results.snippet: Explore the latest monthly updates on industry benchmarks to compare your Google Ads performance across various industries. Access vital metrics such as quality score, impressions, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), and return on ad spend (ROAS).

results.title: Google Ads Benchmarks 2026: CPC, CTR, CVR by Industry
results.snippet: The defining trends of 2026 — CPC inflation, AI bidding dominance, Performance Max expansion, and the widening Quality Score gap — all point in the same direction: the advertisers who will thrive are those who invest in relevance (Quality Score), embrace automation (Smart Bidding and PMax where data supports it), and optimize the full funnel from ad click through conversion (landing page experience). Budget alone is increasingly insufficient to compete. ... Use CPC and CPA benchmarks to forecast required spend by industry. Factor in the 12% YoY CPC increase when building 2027 budgets. Expect 8-10% additional inflation through Q4 2026. ... Compare your CTR and CVR against industry benchmarks to identify gaps. Focus on Quality Score for CPC efficiency. Audit mobile vs desktop segmentation for hidden waste.
